programmes.show_description: In Windsor, Henry Cole finds an Austrian moped that's missing just one key item: an engine. And Simon O'Brien's taken with a fibreglass suit of armour called Ralph.

It's the final day and the B&Bers meet one last time to find out how much they've been paid. Gill and Peter bristle at their feedback and two underpayments, before the winner is announced.

Edinburgh. Business owner and socialite Maz hopes that her top-notch hosting skills, charm offensive and some fantastic fondue will win her the grand on the final night. (Ep5/5)

programmes.show_description: In Maidenhead, Simon O'Brien falls in love with an old ship's carpenter's chest, which he wants to gently restore, while Henry Cole renovates a miniature Tether car.
Simon and his friend Shirley host at The Old Hall Country House in Madeley, Cheshire. Their guests are in awe of the 16th-century building, and are treated to tap dancing and fine dining.
Cat-lover Eileen Finn welcomes her rivals to the four-star Thornley House in Allendale, Northumberland. But Eileen's beloved and very large cats are not to all of her guests' liking.
Jessica and Adrian Rashleigh hope that the beautiful Cornish coastal surroundings will make up for the snugness of the three-bedroom Chy Conyn in St Ives. Will their guests agree?
The final hosts are Tim and Karen at The Cavendish, where activities include a bus tour of Bournemouth. The 'pink palace' impresses their guests, but Simon and Shirley break their bed.
It's the final day of the competition and the B&Bers meet one last time to see how much they've been paid. After a generous overpayment and some harsh criticism, the winner is announced.
Cumbria. The first host, part-time social worker Sara, hopes to impress her guests with a Middle Eastern menu inspired by her birthplace of Baghdad. (Ep1/5)
Cumbria. Bricklayer Dale serves up construction-themed cuisine, including his 'Great Wall of Chinese Chicken', on an evening full of laughs. (Ep2/5)
Cumbria. Council refuse worker Vicki hosts a hospital-themed evening, serving up 'cracked ribs with a blood shot' and bandage-based entertainment. (Ep3/5)
Cumbria. There's some Catalan cuisine and a blindfolded cocktail-making competition as entrepreneur Ash hosts. (Ep4/5)
Cumbria. On the final night, Rob treats his guests to some local produce, but will eggshell in his starter scupper his chances of winning the grand? (Ep5/5)
